pull.title: KAFKA-21349: Wait for the high watermark before loading transaction metadata
pull.body:
When a broker becomes the leader of a `__transaction_state` partition,
`TransactionStateManager` loads the log up to the log end offset. A
newly elected leader can have records above the high watermark that are
not committed yet and can still be truncated if leadership moves again,
even with clean elections. The coordinator then acts on state that is
later rolled back. For example, it can send COMMIT markers for a
PREPARE_COMMIT that the next leader doesn't have, and that leader later
times out and aborts the transaction, so the transaction is committed on
some partitions and aborted on others.

Loading with `FetchIsolation.HIGH_WATERMARK` is not enough, because a
new leader's high watermark can lag behind the true one, so the load
would miss committed records.

The coordinator doesn't write to the partition while it is loading
(requests get `COORDINATOR_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS`), so the log end offset at
the start of the load doesn't change. Once the high watermark reaches
it, every record the load reads is committed. This change:

- In `loadTransactionsForTxnTopicPartition`, if the high watermark is
below the log end offset, registers a `PartitionListener` and schedules
the load once the high watermark reaches the log end offset. The high
watermark is checked again after the listener is added, since an update
between reading it and adding the listener isn't delivered to the
listener.
- Abandons the load (removes the `loadingPartitions` entry) if the
partition is not online, becomes a follower, fails or is deleted before
the high watermark catches up. This runs on the scheduler, since
listeners are invoked with partition locks held.
- Skips partitions that are loading in
`removeExpiredTransactionalIds()`. On a leader epoch bump, the previous
epoch's cache entry stays until the new load replaces it, and tombstones
written for it would move the log end offset while the load waits.
- Logs the time spent waiting for the high watermark as part of the load
time.

In the normal case the wait is about one follower fetch round trip. If
an ISR follower is unavailable, the load waits until it is removed from
the ISR (`replica.lag.time.max.ms`). This does not cover unclean leader
election, where committed records can be lost.

Testing: added unit tests to `TransactionStateManagerTest` for waiting
for the high watermark, abandoning on each partition transition and when
the partition is not online, the high watermark advancing during
listener registration, a leader epoch bump while waiting, and expiration
of a partition that is being reloaded.

commit.message:
KAFKA-21349: Wait for the high watermark before loading transaction metadata

The transaction coordinator loads __transaction_state up to the log end
offset, so a newly elected leader can load records above the high
watermark that may still get truncated, and act on them (e.g. send
COMMIT markers for an uncommitted PREPARE_COMMIT that is later lost).

The coordinator doesn't write to the partition while loading, so the log
end offset is fixed: wait with a PartitionListener until the high
watermark reaches it, then schedule the load. Abandon the load if the
partition becomes a follower, fails or is deleted first, and skip
expiration for partitions that are loading so that tombstones don't move
the log end offset.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Clarify comments on the high watermark wait

timeline.message:
KAFKA-21349: Wait for the high watermark before loading transaction metadata

The transaction coordinator loads __transaction_state up to the log end
offset, so a newly elected leader can load records above the high
watermark that may still get truncated, and act on them (e.g. send
COMMIT markers for an uncommitted PREPARE_COMMIT that is later lost).

The coordinator doesn't write to the partition while loading, so the log
end offset is fixed: wait with a PartitionListener until the high
watermark reaches it, then schedule the load. Abandon the load if the
partition becomes a follower, fails or is deleted first, and skip
expiration for partitions that are loading so that tombstones don't move
the log end offset.
